event_summary: A dark layered cloud mass changes shape and extends across a flat landscape while an orange horizon glow remains visible and small dark specks appear late in the scene.
raw_event_description: The video shows a fixed view over a flat field with a dark sky above and a bright orange band near the right horizon. From the beginning, a large dark cloud mass occupies most of the sky. Over time, layered cloud bands on the left become more pronounced and extend farther toward the center and right. A dark vertical curtain-like region near the center-right horizon remains visible and changes width and edge shape. The orange horizon glow stays visible on the right but becomes increasingly bordered by the dark cloud base. Near the end, several small dark specks appear above the field near the right side and move through the sky.

reasons: The large cloud mass, field, horizon, and orange sky band are already visible in the first frame.
The visible cloud-shape changes appear to be ongoing from the start rather than beginning from a still setup.
